purpose: The provider prices the v0.1 orphan bound was computed with (decisions document 0029, layer C). Token exposure is protocol-bounded by the Campaign's enforced limits; the dollar figure uses provider pricing recorded at release time and is only as current as this record.

profiles.source: Prime Intellect published rate card for qwen/qwen3.7-flash

notes.rates: Highest uncached rates, per million tokens, in US dollars.
notes.context_window_tokens: Not a price. It is the one-turn input overshoot the bound charges for, because Verifiers checks max_input_tokens between turns and a single turn may still carry a whole context window. No context ceiling for this model is published in anything this repository carries, so the release uses 131072 - the largest window in common use for models of this class - which can only make the computed bound larger.
